images.name: whole_labels_minimized
images.review: 3.5 km world without labels. Ridge belts, inlet and woodland masses are present. Materials and road presentation remain provisional; square outer bounds are exposed.

images.name: ordinary_heartland
images.review: Human countryside has room around the unchanged capital core. Some parallel paths and unfinished approaches remain.

images.name: human_capital_scale
images.review: Unchanged owned Human miniature beside lake/tributary. Full authored city untouched. Strategic island/quay correspondence and gate entry are incomplete.

images.name: dwarf_mountains
images.review: Continuous Crownspine relief and small hold reference. Natural bench seating and engineered approaches still need work.

images.name: northern_coast
images.review: Ocean-connected inlet and boreal terrain. Actual Viking harbor miniature/dock composition is not yet placed.

images.name: orc_eastern_terrain
images.review: Owned Mesa forms provide distinct gullies and plateaus. Saturated orange iteration rejected. Source transition and surface treatment remain visible.

images.name: nature_terrain
images.review: Coherent woodland masses, clearings and a downhill river valley. Foliage family diversity and bank art remain provisional.

images.name: dark_southern_terrain
images.review: Southern mountain forms retained. Repeated rock texture rejected in favor of tinted native surface. No fortress horizon yet.

images.name: pass_study
images.review: Relief constrains the route. Road mask has angular bends; this is not finished pass construction.

images.name: ford_candidate
images.review: River Ford is a real channel crossing. The crossroads approach still has a short 25.24 degree grade exception and is not accepted.

images.name: minor_settlement_scale
images.review: Minor buildings remain small relative to terrain. Some bases intersect the slope; scale proof, not finished village placement.

images.name: close_ground_road
images.review: Close material and minor-building inspection. Surface repetition, road edges and seating remain provisional.

images.name: major_river
images.review: Human tributary and lake context. All four centerline profiles descend; bank detail and source transition are unfinished.

images.name: bridge_bank_inspection
images.review: Road bends into the shortest practical measured bank span. Native owned stone bridge seated on banks; lightweight wooden options remain pending source inspection.
